title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Membership Tenure: Rental Rate Points
content:
Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards rewards long membership on Ridgeline Tool Rental rental time through the ProBuild discount rate of the agreement.

**Rule.** Membership tenure adds points: a membership enrolled at least 96 whole calendar months before the checkout date adds 1 point; a membership enrolled at least 48 but fewer than 96 whole calendar months before the checkout date adds half a point (0.5); a membership enrolled fewer than 48 whole calendar months before the checkout date adds none.

The points are added to the ProBuild discount rate of the agreement point for point, whatever the ProBuild tier's own rental discount percentage, a tier percentage of zero included.

Tenure is counted in whole calendar months from the enrollment date on the ProBuild membership record to the checkout date of the agreement.

## Tenure bands

| Whole calendar months from enrollment to checkout | Points added |
|---|---|
| 96 or more | 1 |
| 48 to 95 | 0.5 |
| fewer than 48 | 0 |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical checkout on 10 June 2026)

| Enrollment date | Whole calendar months | Points |
|---|---|---|
| 10 June 2018 | 96 | 1 |
| 11 June 2018 | 95 | 0.5 |
| 10 June 2022 | 48 | 0.5 |
| 11 June 2022 | 47 | 0 |

## Questions answered

- *Does a tier change restart tenure?* Tenure runs from the enrollment date, not from the date the current tier took effect.
- *Is tenure measured to the day the discount is posted?* No; it is measured to the checkout date of the agreement.
